title: WebSocketCloseMapping

x-agp.mechanics: Defines the close-mapping value owned by the WebSocket binding.
x-agp.rationale: Carrier-specific configuration and mapping remain outside the neutral kernel.
x-agp.consequence: Divergence makes WebSocket behavior ambiguous or leaks carrier authority.

description: Sovereign projection from binding condition to empty-reason RFC 6455 close action.

closeCode.description: RFC 6455 close status selected by the binding.

reason.description: Binding-initiated close reasons are always empty.
